search.title: Ersan İlyasova
search.snippet: Ersan İlyasova (born 15 May 1987) is an Uzbek-born Turkish former professional basketball player. He played 13 seasons in the National Basketball Association

search.title: Ersan
search.snippet: Ersan Gülüm, Turkish footballer Ersan İlyasova, Turkish basketball player Ersan Keleş, Turkish-Belgian futsal player Ersan Şen (born 1966), Turkish lawyer
